get.description: Returns outlets with live load, totals, system state, thresholds and recent events.

Returns per-channel voltage, current and power time series for a bounded window (15m|1h|6h|24h|7d), aggregated server-side into fixed time buckets (max 360 points per series). Each channel carries a provenance label: both 220 V mains channels (CH1-CH2) report voltage from the INA226 on the mains feed, and their current is measured on each channel's own ADS1220 SPI input via its branch CT sensor. Empty buckets are returned as null, never zero.
Returns the FR-01..FR-12 event-condition-action framework rule repository, in precedence order.

post.description: Runs the FR-04/FR-05 pre-activation assessment for an outlet and records the decision.
Opens the outlet relay and zeroes its live load (manual toggle-off path).

Disconnects the most expendable energized outlets first (FR-07): lowest load tier first, highest current within a tier. Tier 1 (Critical) is never shed automatically. Set manualOverride to also latch automatic prioritisation off. Returns the shed branches with their tiers, plus P_limit and the recovery limit.

Runs a single step of the staged-restoration ladder: recloses the highest-priority branch the framework shed, once P_total has stayed below the recovery limit for the recovery period. Force skips the recovery-period and inter-reconnect waits (the operator is asserting the load is gone) but NEVER the recovery limit itself. Automatic restoration also runs on every telemetry batch; this endpoint drives or inspects it on demand.

Operator override. While enabled, the framework keeps measuring and keeps raising alarms but opens and closes no relay on its own, and branches already shed are not restored automatically. The change is recorded as a Warning event so an override that outlives the shift is visible in the audit trail.

put.description: Updates priority, allowance, schedule or idle limit for an outlet. The ID in the URL must match the ID in the payload.
Updates capacity, warning/critical limits and standby/idle tuning values.

post.description: Stores a scenario telemetry batch and returns the policy engine's own result: rows stored, aggregate watts, resulting system state, the events it raised, and the load-shedding framework's decision for that batch (including any branch it shed or restored). Metering mode is forced to Simulated because the batch is synthesised.
Stores per-outlet PZEM readings, refreshes live outlet state, and evaluates threshold crossings and fault lockout.

get.description: Returns thresholds and the outlet policy table so the ESP32 can synchronize before evaluating POL-01..POL-08 locally.

post.description: Creates a new todo item using the provided details and returns the ID of the created item.

put.description: Updates the specified todo item. The ID in the URL must match the ID in the payload.

delete.description: Deletes the todo item with the specified ID.

patch.description: Updates the detail fields of a specific todo item. The ID in the URL must match the ID in the payload.

get.description: Retrieves all todo lists along with their items.

post.description: Creates a new todo list using the provided details and returns the ID of the created list.

put.description: Updates the specified todo list. The ID in the URL must match the ID in the payload.

delete.description: Deletes the todo list with the specified ID.

post.description: Authenticates a user. Use ?useCookies=true for cookie-based authentication.
Returns a new access token using a valid refresh token.

get.description: Confirms a user's email address using the token sent by email.

post.description: Sends a new email confirmation link to the specified address.
Sends a password reset link to the specified email address.
Resets a user's password using the token sent by email.
Enables, disables, or retrieves two-factor authentication settings.

get.description: Returns the current user's email and two-factor authentication status.

post.description: Updates the current user's email or password.
Logs out the current user by clearing the authentication cookie.

get.description: Retrieves a list of weather forecasts for the next few days.
